label: Naive vector RAG
description: Naive dense retrieval over the whole corpus with no agent and no map, scored with deterministic hash embeddings.

label: Naive lexical RAG (BM25 top-k)
description: Unrestricted BM25 retrieval over the whole corpus, same top-k cap.

label: Agentic text RAG (no map)
description: Same observe/plan/act loop and deterministic keyword planner, but over flat chunk cards with no document grouping, hierarchy, or adjacency.

label: Map agent (low resolution, 4 chunks/section)
description: Coarse map: 4 chunks per section, so few large sections.

label: Map agent (high resolution, 1 chunk/section)
description: Fine map: 1 chunk per section, so many small sections.

label: Map agent (production default, 6 chunks/section)
description: Deterministic planner, neighbour expansion, one reflection step.

label: Map agent (adaptive, 3 sections/document)
description: Per-document adaptive granularity: every document is divided into about 3 sections instead of a fixed chunks-per-section.

label: Map agent (with candidate refinement)
description: Re-scores the shortlist on full section text before planning. Measured and left off by default because it did not pay for itself.

label: Map agent (no neighbours)
description: Neighbour expansion disabled; only planned sections are routed.

label: Map agent (no reflection)
description: Single step; weak routed evidence is not expanded or re-fetched.

label: Map agent (single section)
description: One section routed with no neighbours; smallest possible context.

label: Map agent (oracle planner)
description: Injected planner returns the ground-truth section. Upper bound only; not an LLM measurement.
